BDEN=47 BL=148 BR=144: an anchor forty columns outside them.
y = BL + (BR−BL)·(x−BXLO)/BDEN — a split copies it verbatim.
WHAT THE WALK ACTUALLY DID, SPAN BY SPAN

THE SAME LIST, ACROSS THE WHOLE FRAME — EVERY SPAN DRAWN AS THE TRAPEZIUM IT REALLY IS, OVER WHAT HAS BEEN PLOTTED SO FAR
It is born as one span, the whole screen. Portals cut it into pieces, solid walls delete the pieces behind them, equal neighbours merge back together. Twelve wall
closes and one object pass later there is nothing open left, so the traversal stops early: 293,676 cycles for this view, and the rest of the tree is never visited.
half-open [lo,hi) everywhere · two compares settle most spans · the trapezoid clip runs only when a boundary genuinely crosses the line · equal neighbours merge once per wall
